chapter: New York, the Lafayette and the Cotton Club
title: Moving to New York and two weeks at the Lafayette Theater
summary: Crawford gives his Harlem addresses and says the Lunceford band played the Lafayette for two weeks because it drew crowds, before the Cotton Club.
